Catalog: PROC CONTENTS source catalog. Metadata-only checks verified the accepted construction fields and their types; bounded scans retained aggregate counts and dates only.

Assigned scientific records: output/samples/records/W2105094056.json, output/models/records/W2105094056.json, output/reproductions/packages/W2105094056/attempt_02/outcome.json, and accepted attempt_02 SAS/Stata code and tables.
changes: Clock arithmetic uses fiscal-year labels (FYEAR): the pre-142 fit requests 2005 after its original 2000 endpoint; both post-142 fits request 2016 after 2011.

Preserved the paper’s policy-defined sample windows: pre-142 FY1996–2000, transition FY2001–2003 excluded, post-142 FY2004–2011. FY2001–2005 cannot extend the pre-142 fit; FY2012–2016 cross the ASU 2011-08 change and cannot extend the accepted post-142 fits as comparable observations.

Raw current-vintage source coverage is available through the requested fiscal-year labels. FY2016 Compustat statements reach DATADATE 2017-05-31; the source boundary is not the limiting factor. No later observations are admitted to the retained fits because preserving the paper’s accounting-regime cutoffs takes precedence.

Replayed the accepted SAS construction and the three original conditional-logit Stata cells from current local named sources. Estimator, coefficients’ model terms, regime windows and established assumptions are retained.
limitations: The paper explicitly ends its primary sample in 2011 because ASU 2011-08 changed the goodwill impairment-testing regime. Later raw data are present, but they do not belong in the same accepted post-142 estimand; the post-142 extension therefore has no added observations.

The pre-142 scope is fixed at FY1996–2000; the paper excludes FY2001–2003 for the SFAS 142 transition, and FY2004–2005 are post-142 observations. The requested 2005 endpoint does not create eligible pre-142 observations.

Carry-forward limitations from the accepted predecessor: Table 3 Panel A fit-specific N and the conditional-logit strata are not reported; GVKEY conditioning is the accepted best-effort choice. The paper does not specify the average-assets endpoints for ROA. The existing currency, fiscal-year duplicate, segment-vintage/type and exact Compustat/CRSP match rules remain disclosed best-effort choices.

Only the three assigned Table 3 Panel A Eq. (1) fits are covered. Other paper analyses and tables, including Table 3 Panel B, Table 4, quarterly figures, and appendix/robustness analyses, are outside the assigned scopes.

The aggregate current-source preflight found one duplicate Compustat GVKEY/FYEAR key in each FY2012–2016, each with two DATADATEs. The accepted latest-DATADATE tie rule resolves these if later observations are ever studied; those years are not admitted to the current fits.

Later current-vintage source rows exist, but no later observation is eligible for this pre-142 fit without changing the specified regime. This disposition was established in preflight from the paper’s dated policy/sample definition and the accepted code; the controller replay succeeded on the retained in-period sample.
